description: SLIDER JOINT GOLDEN (S4a, RESEARCH §21): two instances of the SAME 40 x 25 x 10 mm plate (two r5 through-holes) on ONE slider joint, a carriage riding A's top front edge. Plate A is grounded at the origin; the joint pairs the START of A's top front edge (y = 0, z = 10) with the START of B's bottom front edge (y = 0, z = 0), origin B flipped, and is driven to value lin_mm = 80. B is seeded displaced (5, 3, 17) and spun ~-5.7 deg about Z. Locks: edge_point origins (canonical start, tangent Z), flip (a half turn about the frame's X), translation along A's joint Z with rotation locked, DOF = 1 for a driven slider, and the reported joint state.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED, not recorded pipeline output. The plate's own mass properties are the sketch-extrude-plate-2holes golden's: volume 8429.203673205104 mm^3, surface_area 3614.159265358979 mm^2, centroid (20, 12.5, 5), AABB [0,0,0]..[40,25,10], 8 faces / 18 edges / 1 shell.

Frame A (edge_point start of the edge (0,0,10)-(40,0,10)): start = the endpoint with the smaller (x, y, z) = (0, 0, 10); Z = the unit tangent from start to end = +X; X = reference_x(+X): the least-aligned axes Y and Z tie, Y wins = +Y; Y = Z x X = X x Y = +Z.
Frame B before flip (edge (0,0,0)-(40,0,0), B-local): origin (0, 0, 0), Z = +X, X = +Y, Y = +Z. flip is a half turn about the frame's X: Z -> -X, X stays +Y, Y = Z x X = (-X) x Y = -Z.

Joint relation: F_B = F_A o T with T = Trans(0, 0, offset + lin) o RotZ(angle) o RotX(180 deg), offset 0, angle 0, lin = 80. World B frame: origin (0, 0, 10) + 80 * (+X) = (80, 0, 10); x = +Y, y = -(+Z) = -Z, z = -(+X) = -X.

B's body rotation maps its (flipped) local frame x = +Y, y = -Z, z = -X onto world x = +Y, y = -Z, z = -X: the identity. Its translation puts the local origin (0, 0, 0) at (80, 0, 10): B position (80, 0, 10), orientation (0, 0, 0, 1).

Value 80 moves B exactly 80.000 along A's joint Z (+X) from its value-0 placement (0, 0, 10) (test_assembly_joints pins the difference). B's bottom face stays on A's top plane z = 10: a carriage on a rail.
Joint state: lin_mm = (p_B - p_A) . z_A - offset = ((80, 0, 10) - (0, 0, 10)) . (1, 0, 0) = 80; rot_deg null (a slider has no rotation value); axis_world = A's joint Z = (1, 0, 0).
remaining_dof = 1: six hard rows of rank 5 (lateral position 2 + orientation 3); the driving row places B but removes no DOF, so status is under_constrained.
Probe: B-local origin (0, 0, 0), the start of B's bottom front edge, sits at world (80, 0, 10).
tolerance_rationale: CLOSED-FORM tolerance: a driven joint on a grounded parent is placed by the closed-form snap (no iteration). Measured first (2026-10-09, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, numpy BLAS pinned to 1 thread): B position and rotation exact (0.0 deviation), combined volume within 1.9e-12 mm^3 (summation order). 1e-9 is ~500x the worst observation and 1000x tighter than the numeric goldens' 1e-6. Loosening it requires a reviewed justification here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.

probes.note: start of B's bottom front edge, 80 along A's top front edge
